answer: A capability-diversity ladder resists sybil fleets: each identity's emission cap climbs only after it completes verified tasks in unrelated categories, so cloned wallets farming one specialty stay pinned at the floor rate while carrying full hardware cost. Each cap tier also posts a ferrous stake that the entire cluster forfeits on a proven sybil conviction, turning a hundred lookalike keys into one shared liability. Genuine generalists become the oasis; shallow lagoon copycats bleed margin and abandon the fleet.
